data.function: filter_selectively_horiz (crash site); root cause in av1_filter_block_plane_bitmask_horz
data.bug_class: out-of-bounds read of filter-level array (uninitialized/invalid loop-filter level) leading to OOB indexing of lfi_n->lfthr[64] (UBSan array-bounds / index 243 out of bounds)
data.rationale: Reproduced by fuzzing the built av1_dec_fuzzer (UBSan build) with the project seed corpus. UBSan report: av1/common/av1_loopfilter.c:1326:51 'index 243 out of bounds for type const loop_filter_thresh[64]' in filter_selectively_horiz, stack: filter_selectively_horiz <- av1_filter_block_plane_bitmask_horz (av1_loopfilter.c:1766) <- loop_filter_rows (:2379) <- av1_loop_filter_frame <- av1_decode_tg_tiles_and_wrapup, reachable from LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput via aom_codec_decode. In filter_selectively_horiz the level byte *lfl (pointing into LoopFilterMask.lfl_{y,u,v}_hor[64x64] chosen by av1_filter_block_plane_bitmask_horz at lines 1741/1747/1753) is used as an index into lfthr[MAX_LOOP_FILTER+1]=lfthr[64]; a value of 243 proves the lfl pointer/level data is out of the valid level range (levels are clamped to 0..63 everywhere they are produced by get_filter_level), i.e. the pointer walks off / points into adjacent mask bytes. av1/common/av1_loopfilter.c is also the only source file in the tree with a post-2024 modification timestamp, confirming the injected root cause is in this file; the horz bitmask filtering path (av1_filter_block_plane_bitmask_horz, lines 1709-1772, supplying lfl/row/col and calling filter_selectively_horiz at line 1766) is the root-cause region.
